title: {{name}} and the Big Goal
summary: 苦练后绝杀进球:主角踢不远,老人教盯住球,苦练后大赛打平、最后时刻踢进制胜球。
text:
{{name}} loved to play soccer. Every day after school, {{name}} ran to the park. But there was a problem. {{name}} could not kick the ball far. The other kids could kick well. {{name}} felt sad.

One day, an old man sat near the field. He saw {{name}} try and try. "Do not give up," he said kindly. "Keep your eye on the ball. Then kick hard!"

{{name}} smiled. The next day, {{name}} went to the park early. {{name}} looked at the ball. {{name}} kicked it again and again. The ball went a little far. Then it went far. {{name}} was so happy!

On Saturday, the big game came. {{name}} was on the team. The score was the same for both sides. There was no time left. The ball came to {{name}}.

{{name}} took a deep breath. "Keep your eye on the ball," {{name}} said. {{name}} looked at the ball. {{name}} kicked it hard. The ball flew into the net. Goal!

All the kids ran to {{name}}. "You did it!" they cheered. The old man smiled from his seat.

{{name}} learned a big lesson that day. When you keep trying, good things will come. {{name}} will play soccer for a long, long time.
